briefTitle: A Study to Assess Disease Activity and Adverse Events of Intravenous (IV) Telisotuzumab Vedotin Compared to IV Docetaxel in Adult Participants With Previously Treated Non-Squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

typedChecks.sourceText: An Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 to 1.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: An Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 to 1.

typedChecks.sourceText: Evidence of new, untreated CNS metastases or progressing CNS metastases after treatment.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Evidence of new, untreated CNS metastases or progressing CNS metastases after treatment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Projected life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have c-Met overexpressing non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) as assessed by an AbbVie designated immunohistochemistry (IHC) laboratory using the VENTANA MET (SP44) RxDx assay.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: c-Met overexpression using a specific designated laboratory assay does not map to a standard typed biomarker check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) version 1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have progressed on at least 1 line of prior therapy for locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex rules regarding actionable alterations, platinum-based chemotherapy, and immune checkpoint inhibitor requirements cannot be captured as a single simple prior lines check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must be considered appropriate for docetaxel therapy based on the assessment of the treating physician.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator opinion is a subjective assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with adenosquamous or neuroendocrine histology, nor sarcomatoid features.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Specific excluded histologies like adenosquamous, neuroendocrine, and sarcomatoid features do not fit into the standard allowed typed histologies list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants who have received prior c-Met-targeted antibodies, prior telisotuzumab vedotin, or prior antibody-drug conjugates either targeting c-Met or consisting of monomethylauristatin E.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Multiple prior drug classes and specific agents cannot be combined into a single simple prior_therapy_excluded check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Projected life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: A histologically or cytologically documented non-squamous cell NSCLC that is locally advanced or metastatic.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC is in scope, but lacks a specific numbered stage list for stage_in.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) version 1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants WITHOUT an actionable gene alteration: must have progressed on (or be considered ineligible for) platinum-based chemotherapy and immune checkpoint inhibitor (as monotherapy or in combination with chemotherapy).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex conditional prior therapy requirements based on actionable gene alterations cannot be represented as simple typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must be considered appropriate for docetaxel therapy based on the assessment of the treating physician.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator discretion regarding treatment appropriateness is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Evidence of leptomeningeal disease.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Leptomeningeal disease is a specific CNS exclusion not covered by general brain_mets kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with adenosquamous or neuroendocrine histology, nor sarcomatoid features.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of specific rare histologies is not fully covered by the standard histology_in inclusion list.
